title: Withdrawal notices (three manuscripts)
note: All three notices open with "Withdrawn on October 6, 2026." and close with "This withdrawal concerns the proof; it does not assert that the mathematical statement is false." The sign-error equation appears in the notice for "Algebraicity of Weil classes on split abelian eightfolds" (https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/Algebraicity-of-Weil-classes-on-split-abelian-eightfolds-September-18-2026/paper.pdf). The two dependent withdrawals are "The rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces" (https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/The-rational-Hodge-conjecture-for-products-of-K3-surfaces-October-4-2026/hodge-conjecture-products-k3.pdf) and "Algebraicity of Kuga-Satake Correspondences for K3 Surfaces" (https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/Algebraicity-of-Kuga-Satake-Correspondences-for-K3-Surfaces-October-3-2026/manuscript.pdf).
